# Capability ownership

One authoritative writer per exclusive global property or external contract; separate identity domains are permitted where their scopes genuinely differ.

A process-scoped PIF/DroidGuard identity is a separate domain from installed OTA identity and is not required to match it.

## Capability matrix

| Capability | Exclusive | Authority | Mutable | Transaction / Restore boundary | Reboot boundary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `installed_ota_static_identity` | `true` | `stock-os+ota-authority` | `false` | read-only validation | OTA boot boundary |
| `raw_boot_avb_evidence` | `true` | `bootloader+libavb` | `false` | read-only evidence | boot |
| `global_sensitive_props` | `true` | `selected-pif-provider` | `true` | provider-owned; OTAST verifies conflicts | zygote/process and reboot dependent |
| `pif_profile` | `true` | `selected-pif-provider+user-profile` | `true` | provider-owned canonical source; OTAST transactionally owns non-source mirrors only | GMS process restart; module update may require reboot |
| `platform_system_spl` | `true` | `otast-from-ota-authority` | `true` | OTAST managed system.prop | reboot after Apply |
| `platform_vendor_spl` | `true` | `otast-from-ota-authority` | `true` | OTAST managed system.prop | reboot after Apply |
| `trickystore_patch` | `true` | `otast` | `true` | OTAST external-contract transaction | consumer dependent |
| `key_attestation` | `true` | `trickystore-oss` | `true` | provider-owned; OTAST observes health only | provider dependent |

| `target_list` | `false` | `trickystore-target-data` | `true` | external user/provider data; compatibility UIs may edit | none unless consumer requires it |

| `root_concealment` | `false` | `external-concealment-modules` | `false` | observed only | provider dependent |
| `lsposed_environment` | `false` | `vector-or-other-framework` | `false` | observed only | reboot/zygote |

## Preferred stack policy

This is a recommendation boundary, not an uninstall instruction. Compatibility adapters remain supported only where their reviewed writers can be neutralized and restored deterministically.

- **Required Or Primary**: `otast`, `trickystore`, `one-pif-provider`, `one-zygisk-provider`
- **Optional**: `better-known-installed`, `vector`, `root-concealment`, `ashrexcue`
- **Not Preferred**: `yurikey`, `vbmeta-fixer`, `ta-utl-property-governor`, `multiple-pif-providers`, `multiple-zygisk-providers`, `multiple-key-attestation-providers`

## Historical convergence

- `ota-sot` transaction/Restore invariants are retained by the current OTAST transaction engine; its OTA-to-PIF identity coupling is superseded.
- `otasst` capability separation and non-target treatment are adopted here without porting its CAS/state engine wholesale.
- PR #41 canonical PIF ownership, immutable mirror generations and staged-promotion semantics remain authoritative.
- TA UTL remains a compatibility adapter because current upstream reads `boot_hash` before `disable_prop_handler`; a source/WebUI boundary is still required for safe target-list-only coexistence.
- Yurikey and Android VBMeta Fixer are compatibility adapters, not preferred authority providers.
